'''Huan Mallia''' is the captain of the ''[[Gray Gull]]''.

==Appearance==
Captain Mallia is a tall man with a dark pointed beard and pale blue eyes.{{ref/book|3|32}}

==Activities==
Captain Mallia lets [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] travel aboard his ship when they run aboard at the last minute at the docks of [[Tar Valon]]. After charging an exorbitant amount of money, Mat and Thom get to take his cabin and his meals.{{ref/book|3|32}} Captain Mallia is glad to see the back of the two men in [[Aringill]] after his massive gambling losses to Mat as well as Mat eating through what should have fed his crew from Tar Valon to [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|40}}
